# Librerías 
```{r}
pacman::p_load(dplyr, purrr, tidyr, here, lme4, flextable, officer)
```

### Funciones

#### Tipo de texto

```{r}
fmt2   <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x) #Escribe numeros con dos decimales
fmt_sc <- function(x) sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.2f", x)) # Dos decimales pero sin el 0 inicial
```

#### Esportar tabla word APA

```{r}
guardar_tabla_apa <- function(tabla, numero, titulo, nota, archivo, nota_p = TRUE) {

  # 1. Formato de la tabla
  linea <- fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)
  ft <- flextable(tabla) %>%
    font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
    fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
    border_remove() %>%
    hline_top(border = linea, part = "header") %>%
    hline_bottom(border = linea, part = "header") %>%
    hline_bottom(border = linea, part = "body") %>%
    align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") %>%
    align(j = 2:ncol(tabla), align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    autofit()

  # 2. Estilos de texto
  t12 <- function(...) fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 12, ...)
  t10 <- function(...) fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 10, ...)

  # 3. Documento Word
  doc <- read_docx()
  doc <- body_add_fpar(doc, fpar(ftext(paste("Tabla", numero), t12(bold = TRUE))))
  doc <- body_add_fpar(doc, fpar(ftext(titulo, t12(italic = TRUE))))
  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft, align = "left")
  doc <- body_add_fpar(doc, fpar(ftext("Nota. ", t10(italic = TRUE)), ftext(nota, t10())))
  if (nota_p) {
    doc <- body_add_fpar(doc, fpar(
      ftext("*", t10()), ftext("p", t10(italic = TRUE)), ftext(" < .05. **", t10()),
      ftext("p", t10(italic = TRUE)), ftext(" < .01. ***", t10()),
      ftext("p", t10(italic = TRUE)), ftext(" < .001.", t10())))
  }
  print(doc, target = file.path(dir_out, archivo))

  ft
}
```

#Configuración 

```{r}
cohortes <- c("CIVED_1999", "ICCS_2009", "ICCS_2016", "PACES_2019")

etiq <- c(CIVED_1999 = "CIVED 1999", ICCS_2009 = "ICCS 2009",
          ICCS_2016  = "ICCS 2016",  PACES_2019 = "PACES 2019")

dir_out <- here("output", "modelos_escrito")
dir.create(dir_out, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

#Cargar los modelos

```{r}
MODELOS <- lapply(setNames(cohortes, cohortes), function(co)
  readRDS(here("output", "modelos_rds", paste0("modelos_", co, ".rds"))))
```

# ICC

```{r}
datos_icc <- map_dfr(cohortes, function(co) {
  m0    <- MODELOS[[co]]$M0
  tau00 <- as.numeric(VarCorr(m0)$id_colegio)
  tibble(
    cohorte = co,
    tau00   = tau00,
    icc     = tau00 / (tau00 + pi^2 / 3),
    n_est   = nobs(m0),
    n_esc   = ngrps(m0)[["id_colegio"]]
  )
})

datos_icc
```

### Tabla ICC

```{r}
tabla_icc <- datos_icc %>%
  transmute(cohorte         = etiq[cohorte],
            `ICC`           = fmt_sc(icc),
            `τ₀₀`           = fmt2(tau00),
            `N estudiantes` = as.character(n_est),
            `N escuelas`    = as.character(n_esc)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-cohorte, names_to = "Indicador") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cohorte, values_from = value)

nota_icc <- paste0(
  "ICC = τ₀₀ / (τ₀₀ + π²/3), calculado con el modelo nulo (M0: intercepto aleatorio por escuela, sin predictores) ",
  "de un modelo logístico multinivel, con todos los casos disponibles de cada cohorte; π²/3 es la varianza residual ",
  "de la distribución logística. Indica la proporción de la variación en la expectativa de voto (en la escala logit) ",
  "que se encuentra entre escuelas. τ₀₀ = varianza del intercepto aleatorio.")

guardar_tabla_apa(tabla_icc, "X", "Correlación intraclase (ICC) del modelo nulo, por cohorte",
                  nota_icc, "tabla_ICC_M0.docx", nota_p = FALSE)
```

### Estrellas de significancia

```{r}
estrellas <- function(p) {
  case_when(p < .001 ~ "***",
            p < .01  ~ "**",
            p < .05  ~ "*",
            TRUE     ~ "")
}
```


#Tabla modelos 

```{r}
coef_m2 <- map_dfr(cohortes, function(co) {
  cf <- summary(MODELOS[[co]]$M2)$coefficients
  tibble(
    cohorte = co,
    termino = rownames(cf),
    est     = cf[, "Estimate"],
    ee      = cf[, "Std. Error"],
    p       = cf[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    or       = exp(est),
    lo       = exp(est - 1.96 * ee),
    hi       = exp(est + 1.96 * ee),
    estrella = estrellas(p)
  )

coef_m2

```
